title: Nursery Rhymes
text:
Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star is a famous nursery rhyme. Children sing it in many English-speaking countries. The song is about a small star in the night sky. The star shines very bright.

Another popular rhyme is Baa, Baa, Black Sheep. A little boy has a sheep with black wool. The sheep gives wool to the boy. Children clap their hands when they sing this song.

questions.text: What is Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star about?
options: a small star in the night sky
a big dog in the park
a red car on the road
a hot sun in the morning

questions.text: What do children do when they sing Baa, Baa, Black Sheep?
Why are these rhymes good for young children?
options: They are short, simple, and easy to remember
They are long and very difficult to sing
They explain how to drive a car
They are only meant for adults to read

questions.text: Where would you most likely hear these rhymes?
options: in a nursery or at home
in a bank during business hours

vocabulary.definition: the thick hair of a sheep

paragraph_translations: Twinkle, Twinkle, Little Star — відома дитяча римівка. Діти співають її у багатьох англомовних країнах. Пісня про маленьку зірку на нічному небі. Зірка сяє дуже яскраво.
Ще одна популярна римівка — Baa, Baa, Black Sheep. Маленький хлопчик має вівцю з чорною вовною. Вівця дає вовну хлопчикові. Діти плескають у долоні, коли співають цю пісню.
